title: Dual-Stack IPv4 and IPv6 Branch Network
summary: Design, deploy, and verify dual-stack IPv4 and IPv6 enterprise branch connectivity using static and default routing across a hub-and-spoke transit topology. Configure simultaneous IPv4 and IPv6 addressing, establish dual-stack default gateways, and isolate routing misconfigurations in Cisco IOS environments.
learning_objectives: Configure dual-stack IPv4 and IPv6 interface addressing and link-local scopes on branch and core routers
Implement simultaneous IPv4 and IPv6 static and default routes across point-to-point transit networks
Verify end-to-end bidirectional dual-stack reachability between remote branch LAN subnets
Diagnose and resolve routing anomalies including invalid next-hop IP addresses and missing IPv6 default routes
Validate routing tables, neighbor discovery tables, and ARP tables for deterministic dual-stack forwarding

source.origin: Independently authored enterprise dual-stack branch routing laboratory aligned with CCNA Enterprise infrastructure and IPv6 transition guidelines
